records.board: One weekly board for leads and active jobs; phase, owner, next event/date, booked/actual hours and linked evidence.
records.scope: One accepted scope/cost/ownership sheet per client.
records.receipt: One cumulative work/QA receipt per client; append status, changes, incidents, releases and monthly service sections.
records.systems: Existing secure access manager and invoicing system; no duplicate credential or cash ledger.

booking: Dated capability evidence from founder-calendar.readiness_gate plus actual calendar and cash check. No fixed practice-hour/week gate.

calibration.website: Measure three paid builds per tier before broader throughput claims; stop new timing promises if two comparable jobs exceed estimate by20%. Honor accepted jobs.
calibration.care: Complete at least one paid quarter including the dependency/recovery review, actual incident and coordination time, plus startup/exit allocation or timed exit drill. Two months alone do not validate quarterly work.
calibration.search: Two complete paid cycles with approved facts, minor fix, factual revision, QA, coordination and reserve before widening availability.

global_rules: One named client approver; no silence-as-acceptance
No priced extra without written scope/fee/date approval
Human reviews facts, integration and production release
Synthetic test leads; minimize real personal data in AI context
Keep paid client-owned site/accounts usable on service cancellation
No new starts when actual incident/review load consumes booked recovery
